headline: Creative Director

experience.title: Creative Director
bullets: Lead a team of eight designers, writers and video editors serving tourism, cooperative and NGO clients.
Set the creative direction for campaigns and review work at every stage, from brief to final files.
Led the rebrand of a provincial coffee cooperative, whose sales to Manila cafés tripled in two years.
Plan media placements with clients and work with Manila agencies on national campaigns.

experience.title: Senior Graphic Designer
bullets: Designed brand identities, print campaigns and publications for hotels and schools.
Laid out annual reports and coffee-table books in InDesign.

summary: Creative director with twelve years in branding, print and video for tourism and cultural clients in the Cordillera and Manila. I turn briefs into campaign ideas, guide designers and editors through each stage, and make sure every piece stays true to the brand. I also handle media planning and agency partners.
skills: Reviewing work at each creative stage

education.credential: Bachelor of Fine Arts, major in Visual Communication
